reference_sections.14: Freeze after diagnostic numerical coverage; do not change numerical implementation based on held-out results. Actual implementation bug requires invalidation, fix, new freeze, full heldout rerun.

reference_sections.33: Frozen implementation before heldout plus completed causal ablations/flow/operator/policy/serving/closed-loop artifacts are all required.

withdrawn_inference: A freeze predating causal ablations is not itself a protocol failure or an automatic requirement to repeat the complete campaign; that ordering appears in the reference plan.
remaining_requirements: Actual complete causal and local attribution audits for all4 models.
Independent heldout proofs bound to a prior qualified numerical freeze, with unchanged numerical sources/configuration/checkpoint.

If any late study identifies an actual full-path implementation bug or causes a numerical-path change, invalidate affected prior heldout acceptance, requalify and freeze a new revision, and rerun the full properly exposure-qualified heldout campaign.
